svg.title: Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime: seven connected capabilities
svg.desc: A central Qwen logo connects multilingual reasoning, long-context instructions, tool execution, persona and empathy, duplex coordination, reliability, and a persistent voice-agent runtime.
svg.text: Spoken questions. Native audio. Reasoned answers.
Reason across languages, meaning, and acoustic context.
Keep the goal. Track the changes. Retain the constraints.
Find a route to the airport.
Avoid toll roads. Arrive before 6 pm.
New destination → same time and toll constraints.
工具调用与可执行动作
Turn spoken intent into verifiable outcomes.
Check → clarify → confirm → act → report the result
Search when needed. Acknowledge without claiming success.
Understand the feeling, not only the transcript.
“I practiced all week... but I’m still nervous.”
“That makes sense. Let’s take it one step at a time.”
Stay factual. Verify first. Know the limits.
Confirm before committing to an action.
SYSTEM EXTENSION · foreground + background + bounded memory
